about: The client rule for motion.knots (CONTRACT.md, Vehicle): where a marker stands at time t, in metres along path + path_beyond. Before the first knot: 0. Between two knots: linear in metres by time; equal metres = dwell at a Stop. After the last knot: its metres, until the next snapshot. Every client tests its mover against these cases; internal/model/motion_test.go checks them against a reference implementation.

cases.name: two stops ahead, dwell at the first
standing at a Stop until it leaves
arrival and departure at the same time give one knot
